searchText: Just a heads up. Someone I was talking to who was trying the testnet was playing with the generator and didn't notice he overwrote his validator set keys. He didn't create a backup for his keys before this. Oh, should probably post this on testnet is it time to create a "governance" channel here? With all due respect <@!527027407228502037>, I think it's very valuable to just keep on focusing on tech for at least the next few weeks. We almost reached 5 clients on the same testnet, and dev iteration like this is important. Then start to talk about governance (with all its distractions) when we dare to take on an incentivized testnet later. Good idea > With all due respect <@!527027407228502037>, I think it's very valuable to just keep on focusing on tech for at least the next few weeks. We almost reached 5 clients on the same testnet, and dev iteration like this is important. Then start to talk about governance (with all its distractions) when we dare to take on an incentivized testnet later. <@!203220829473996800> want to clarify this is not intended at all to distract the devs, but some others may be able to help with this Although this discord has grown to function as more than just a research/dev channel, its primary purpose is still R&D, and I feel like in this stage governance is a distraction. I think an incentivized testnet would be the turning point, where we should be including governance, but not right now. and even then, maybe that should happen in a different discord. one setup specifically for testnet participants Yes, we could have discord bots helping with common testnet tasks and data, we can have focused introduction/newbie channels, we could have channels to track testing/participation/3rd party tools. Kind of what Prysm had to extend their discord with after they grew so large. Managing a lot of users and governance is difficult, and noisy for developers at best. I very much appreciate users and governance, but extending this R&D discord right now would hurt Eth2 more than it would help any kind of decision making process. That said, there are many other channels, and if there's a need for it right now, those could be used. Maybe you can reach out to the r/EthStaker guys, they have a discord, and would be good outreach to stakers We are working on a discord for Eth 1 governance. Probably wouldn't make sense for Eth 2, bit might be a place to figure outways to work with discord. Would highly recommend following proto and Danny’s advice. > Probably wouldn't make sense for Eth 2 why couldn't it be channel/s in that Discord?
